changelog: Status Bar Inset Handling: Zero header clipping under system status bars and camera notches
Release Signing Identity: Dedicated release keystore configuration eliminating package update conflicts
In-App Updater CDN Redirects: Multi-hop S3 redirect following and auto-resuming unknown source install
Dynamic Format Auto-Selection: Video and image format chips dynamically match input file extensions
Batch Folder Processing: Cleans folders with mixed media formats and packages results into ZIP archives
Dynamic Privacy Impact Card: Real-time privacy profile and sanitization preview before execution
Target Card UI Overhaul: Clean empty state and mounted details with active Change/Clear controls
Collapsible Execution Monitor: Clean telemetry progress metrics with expandable monospace console
Context-Aware Action Dock: Transitions through Select Target, Execute, Cancel, and Run Another
Persistent Tool Preferences: Remembers configured options per engine across sessions
